summary: The retrieved content consists of C# classes and methods related to the management of Assessment Templates within the HSPnet system. The main class, AssessmentTemplate, encapsulates the properties of an assessment template, while several methods perform searches and data retrieval based on various IDs such as TemplateCodeID, TimeTableID, CourseID, StudentID, and CohortID.
purpose: To define and manage assessment templates, including facilitating searches by different parameters (e.g., time table, course, student) within the HSPnet system.

fields.description: A description of the assessment template.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: The order in which the template appears.
